model_output.rationale: CO-29 on all three lines with N211. Payer is commercial CI, not Medicare — N211 carries no regulatory bar to appeal here. The 277CA (ACK59398832, 2024-07-18) shows TRC59398832 accepted A2 five days after the DOS, well inside any commercial filing window. The 837P resubmission on 2025-03-30 is what triggered CO-29; the original filing was timely. Proof of prior acceptance → appeal to dispute payer's receipt date.

root_cause.explanation: All three lines denied CO-29. The 837P was transmitted 2025-03-30 (~8.5 months post-DOS), but 277CA ACK59398832 proves TRC59398832 was accepted A2 on 2024-07-18 — five days after DOS — establishing a prior timely submission.

next_action.detail: File a commercial appeal attaching 277CA ACK59398832 (dated 2024-07-18, status A2, TRC59398832) as proof of timely original submission. Dispute the payer's receipt date; do not plead forgiveness. N211 does not bar appeal on a CI claim.

evidence.fact: All three service lines carry CO-29 with MOA N211; payer production date 2025-04-16; filing indicator CI (commercial).
evidence.locator: CAS CO-29 lines 1-3; CLM filing indicator CI

evidence.fact: TRC59398832 received 2024-07-18, status A2 (accepted for adjudication) — five days after DOS 2024-07-13.
Same TRC59398832 used as submission reference on 837P dated 2025-03-30, the submission that drew CO-29.
evidence.locator: Loop 2300 REF submission reference TRC59398832, interchange date 250330

evidence.fact: Prior accepted submission inside the window → appeal with clearinghouse acceptance report; dispute receipt date.

citations.rule: Proof of accepted submission inside the window → appeal with clearinghouse acceptance report; dispute receipt date.
CO-29 with no appeal basis → do_not_resubmit; but proof of prior timely filing IS the appeal basis → appeal instead.
